thread:
andrew-finance: quick heads up — AWS Marketplace invoice for Sep has several usage lines with no subscription_id or customer_metadata. reconciliation script is throwing these into UNMAPPED and we can't issue correct reseller credits. sample attached below.

emma-partner-ops: ugh. do you have the raw CSV snippet?

andrew-finance: yup — see snippet: 
```
invoice_id,usage_start,usage_end,sku,quantity,amount,subscription_id,customer_id,custom_id
inv-2026-09-01,2026-09-01,2026-09-01,rdw-prod-embed,1,12.50,,acct-99877,
inv-2026-09-02,2026-09-02,2026-09-02,rdw-prod-embed,5,62.50,,acct-99877,
inv-2026-09-05,2026-09-05,2026-09-05,rdw-dedicated-hour,10,1080.72,sub-ABCD123,,
```

andrew-finance: first two lines missing subscription_id and custom_id — total ~$75 impacted. but the third line is mapped (sub exists) and is the $1,080.72 chunk. overall this creates a $1,155.72 lump that we can't auto-assign.

jake-ar: do we have a policy for manual credits when marketplace metadata is missing? need GL and approval. tagging sophia.

sophia-sales: ok to do manual credit for partner if amount verified and partner acknowledges — keep under $5k for self-approval. can proceed if finance signs off.

andrew-finance: I'll verify totals and attach proof. my reconcile query used to surface unmapped lines: 
```sql
select invoice_id, sum(amount) as amt from aws_marketplace_usage where subscription_id is null group by invoice_id;
```

emma-partner-ops: i'm opening a partner support ticket and will request metadata backfill for the 3 days. also sending partner a heads-up so they don't dispute the manual credit.

billing-bot: created support case AWS-CASE-987654321 and linked to ticket AMZ-123456789 (internal).

jake-ar: ok — finance, confirm final amount and GL code. once confirmed i'll push manual credit and note reversal if AWS backfills. what's GL? use 5412 (Marketplace COGS credits)

andrew-finance: confirmed total to credit = 1155.72. GL = 5412. tagging docs: ref internal memo INV-MAP-2026-09-1155.72.

sophia-sales: noted. go ahead. please cc me on partner memo.

emma-partner-ops: sending partner email now, requesting sign-off. will update thread with partner response.

andrew-finance: manual credit queued in systems. i'll hold final close until AWS confirms backfill. thanks all. :thumbsup:

aws-support-bot: partner support replied: requested backfill for usage lines dated 2026-09-01..2026-09-03, ETA 72 hours. case AWS-CASE-987654321.

emma-partner-ops: perfect. i'll reconcile once backfill arrives and reverse any duplicate if needed.

andrew-finance: closing loop here after backfill. created task FIN-2026-09-aws-metadata-fix to track root cause.

jake-ar: credit issued and logged. closing from AR side.

andrew-finance: thanks team — leaving the ticket open until backfill confirmed.
